title: OutbreakFlow: Model-based Bayesian inference of disease outbreak dynamics with invertible neural networks and its application to the COVID-19 pandemics in Germany.
summary: The method was applied to German COVID-19 outbreak data; posterior predictive re-simulation was compared with observed time series. Conclusions depend on the selected epidemic model and available observational data.

evidence.tested: The method was applied to German COVID-19 outbreak data; posterior predictive re-simulation was compared with observed time series.
evidence.unknown: Conclusions depend on the selected epidemic model and available observational data.
evidence.ai_role: OutbreakFlow uses invertible neural networks for Bayesian inference on observed outbreak time series, enabling retrospective analysis of German COVID-19 data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
